transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, such as gardening, one week after surgery. However, you should avoid strenuous, heavy exercise for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for clarifying that. I was also wondering, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using any eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it's safe to continue using them unless you've been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's good to know. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside.
